name: Safe refactoring
description: Tests checked before touching the code, a plan you approve, refactoring with no behaviour changes, a new check.
goalHint: Say what to reorganize and why (e.g. 'split src/services/orders.ts into smaller modules'), and what must not change.

data.label: Initial tests
data.role: Tester: establishes the starting state of the suite.
data.instructions: Run the test suite before any change and report the outcome. If some tests already fail, list them: they will serve as a reference. Do not modify files.

data.label: Plan
data.role: Designer: proposes a refactoring in small, verifiable steps.
data.instructions: Study the code named in the goal and propose a refactoring plan in small steps, without changing the observable behaviour. State the risks and which tests protect each step. Do not modify files.

data.label: Approve the plan
data.instructions: Read the plan. Approve, or reject saying what to change before the code is touched.

data.label: Refactoring
data.role: Developer: restructures the code without changing its behaviour.
data.instructions: Apply the approved plan one step at a time. Do not change the observable behaviour or the existing tests. Run the suite at the end.

data.label: Check
data.role: Tester: compares the suite with the starting state.
data.instructions: Run the test suite and compare it with the initial outcome. Outcome 'ko' if a test that passed before now fails. Do not modify files.

data.label: Final approval
data.instructions: Check the verification and the git diff. Approve, or reject explaining what to fix.
